Drumbeats, music and a band marked the family function at Kala Jathedi’s Sonipat home, where he attended the naming ceremony of his twin daughters.

Delhi Court granted the gangster parole for the visit, and reports cited a police deployment of 100 personnel. The reports gave different durations for the parole—five, six and seven hours—and said he returned to Tihar Jail after the function.
